summaries.zh-Hans: 实时显示内存占用的托盘小组件（active + wired + compressor），同内置内存件。
summaries.en: Tray widget showing live memory usage (active + wired + compressor pages).

descriptions.zh-Hans:
指标风格的内存占用小组件：

- 数据源用 `vm_stat` 统计 active + wired + compressor 页数 × 页大小，除以物理内存
- 详情行显示「已用 / 总量 GB」
- 可见时每秒刷新，收起自动停表；阈值配色与内置件一致

源码与内置内存件同款，导入后可自由改造。
descriptions.en:
Metric-style memory usage widget:

- Data source sums active + wired + compressor pages from `vm_stat`, multiplied by page size, divided by physical memory
- Detail line shows used / total in GB
- Refreshes every second while visible, pauses when hidden; same threshold colors as the built-in widget

Same source as the built-in memory widget; customize freely after importing.
